queries.name: Monthly Revenue Trend
queries.description: Total revenue per month — spot growth, dips, seasonality
queries.use_case: CFO dashboard, monthly close, board reporting
queries.sql:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('month', invoice_date) AS month,
  SUM(amount)                       AS total_revenue,
  COUNT(*)                          AS invoice_count
FROM invoices
WHERE invoice_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '12 months'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

queries.name: Accounts Receivable Aging
queries.description: Outstanding invoices bucketed by days overdue (0-30, 31-60, 61-90, 90+)
queries.use_case: Collections, cash-flow forecasting, credit risk
queries.sql:
SELECT
  customer_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN days_overdue BETWEEN 0  AND 30 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS current_0_30,
  SUM(CASE WHEN days_overdue BETWEEN 31 AND 60 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS past_due_31_60,
  SUM(CASE WHEN days_overdue BETWEEN 61 AND 90 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS past_due_61_90,
  SUM(CASE WHEN days_overdue > 90              THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS past_due_90_plus
FROM (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    amount,
    GREATEST(0, CURRENT_DATE - due_date) AS days_overdue
  FROM invoices
  WHERE paid_at IS NULL
) aged
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY (past_due_61_90 + past_due_90_plus) DESC;

queries.name: Month-over-Month Revenue Change
queries.description: Revenue vs prior month with absolute and percentage change
queries.use_case: Executive summary, finance review meetings
queries.sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', invoice_date) AS month,
    SUM(amount)                       AS revenue
  FROM invoices
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  month,
  revenue,
  LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)                                         AS prev_revenue,
  revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)                               AS change,
  ROUND(100.0 * (revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month))
        / NULLIF(LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 0), 2)                  AS pct_change
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month;

queries.name: Top Vendors by Spend (Last 90 Days)
queries.description: Rank vendors by total purchase spend over a rolling 90-day window
queries.use_case: Procurement review, vendor negotiations, AP analysis
queries.sql:
SELECT
  vendor_id,
  vendor_name,
  SUM(amount)  AS total_spend,
  COUNT(*)     AS invoice_count,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(amount) / SUM(SUM(amount)) OVER (), 2) AS pct_of_total
FROM purchase_invoices
WHERE invoice_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days'
GROUP BY vendor_id, vendor_name
ORDER BY total_spend DESC
LIMIT 20;

queries.name: Sales Pipeline by Stage
queries.description: Opportunity count and total value at each pipeline stage
queries.use_case: Weekly pipeline review, forecasting, rep coaching
queries.sql:
SELECT
  stage,
  COUNT(*)          AS opportunities,
  SUM(deal_value)   AS total_value,
  AVG(deal_value)   AS avg_deal_size
FROM opportunities
WHERE is_closed = FALSE
GROUP BY stage
ORDER BY CASE stage
  WHEN 'Prospecting'   THEN 1
  WHEN 'Qualification' THEN 2
  WHEN 'Proposal'      THEN 3
  WHEN 'Negotiation'   THEN 4
  WHEN 'Closed Won'    THEN 5
  ELSE 99
END;

queries.name: Rep Quota Attainment
queries.description: Each sales rep's closed revenue vs quota for the current quarter
queries.use_case: Sales manager 1:1s, comp calculations, QBRs
queries.sql:
SELECT
  r.rep_name,
  q.quota_amount,
  COALESCE(SUM(o.deal_value), 0)                                           AS closed_revenue,
  ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(o.deal_value), 0) / NULLIF(q.quota_amount, 0), 1) AS attainment_pct
FROM reps r
JOIN quotas q  ON q.rep_id = r.rep_id
             AND q.quarter = DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE)
LEFT JOIN opportunities o ON o.owner_rep_id = r.rep_id
                         AND o.close_date >= DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE)
                         AND o.stage = 'Closed Won'
GROUP BY r.rep_name, q.quota_amount
ORDER BY attainment_pct DESC;

queries.name: Customer Lifetime Value (Simple)
queries.description: Total revenue per customer with first and most recent order dates
queries.use_case: Customer segmentation, retention scoring, upsell targeting
queries.sql:
SELECT
  customer_id,
  MIN(order_date)   AS first_order,
  MAX(order_date)   AS last_order,
  COUNT(*)          AS order_count,
  SUM(order_value)  AS lifetime_value
FROM orders
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY lifetime_value DESC;

queries.name: Daily Orders & GMV
queries.description: Orders placed and gross merchandise value per day
queries.use_case: Ops dashboard, flash reporting, anomaly detection
queries.sql:
SELECT
  order_date::date        AS day,
  COUNT(*)                AS orders,
  SUM(order_value)        AS gmv,
  AVG(order_value)        AS aov
FROM orders
WHERE order_date >= CURRENT_DATE - 30
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

queries.name: Product Return Rate
queries.description: Return rate by SKU — units returned / units sold
queries.use_case: Merchandising review, quality control, supplier accountability
queries.sql:
SELECT
  p.sku,
  p.product_name,
  SUM(o.quantity)                                            AS units_sold,
  COALESCE(SUM(r.quantity), 0)                               AS units_returned,
  ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(r.quantity), 0)
        / NULLIF(SUM(o.quantity), 0), 2)                    AS return_rate_pct
FROM order_items o
JOIN products p   ON p.product_id = o.product_id
LEFT JOIN returns r ON r.order_item_id = o.order_item_id
GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name
HAVING SUM(o.quantity) > 10
ORDER BY return_rate_pct DESC;

queries.name: Cart Abandonment Rate
queries.description: Percentage of carts that were created but never converted to an order
queries.use_case: Conversion optimisation, email retargeting, UX research
queries.sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.session_id)                            AS carts_created,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.session_id)                            AS carts_converted,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.session_id)
    - COUNT(DISTINCT o.session_id)                        AS carts_abandoned,
  ROUND(100.0 * (COUNT(DISTINCT c.session_id)
    - COUNT(DISTINCT o.session_id))
    / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.session_id), 0), 2)         AS abandonment_rate_pct
FROM carts c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.session_id = c.session_id
WHERE c.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - 30;

queries.name: Headcount by Department
queries.description: Active employee count and average tenure per department
queries.use_case: Org planning, workforce reporting, budget allocation
queries.sql:
SELECT
  department,
  COUNT(*)                                                         AS headcount,
  ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CURRENT_DATE, hire_date))), 1)    AS avg_tenure_years
FROM employees
WHERE termination_date IS NULL
GROUP BY department
ORDER BY headcount DESC;

queries.name: Attrition Rate (Rolling 12 Months)
queries.description: Voluntary and involuntary attrition rate over the last 12 months
queries.use_case: CHRO reporting, retention strategy, exit interview analysis
queries.sql:
WITH avg_headcount AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS avg_hc
  FROM employees
  WHERE hire_date <= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '12 months'
     OR termination_date IS NULL
)
SELECT
  COUNT(CASE WHEN reason = 'Voluntary'   THEN 1 END) AS voluntary_exits,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN reason = 'Involuntary' THEN 1 END) AS involuntary_exits,
  COUNT(*)                                           AS total_exits,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / NULLIF(ah.avg_hc, 0), 2) AS attrition_rate_pct
FROM employees e
CROSS JOIN avg_headcount ah
WHERE e.termination_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '12 months' AND CURRENT_DATE;

queries.name: 7 / 30 / 90-Day Rolling Revenue
queries.description: Rolling revenue windows for short, medium, and long-term trend comparison
queries.use_case: CEO/CFO dashboard, investor updates, weekly business review
queries.sql:
SELECT
  CURRENT_DATE                                                 AS as_of,
  SUM(CASE WHEN order_date >= CURRENT_DATE -  7 THEN revenue END) AS rev_7d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN order_date >= CURRENT_DATE - 30 THEN revenue END) AS rev_30d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN order_date >= CURRENT_DATE - 90 THEN revenue END) AS rev_90d
FROM daily_revenue;

queries.name: Year-over-Year Growth by Business Unit
queries.description: Revenue this year vs last year per BU with YoY growth percentage
queries.use_case: Annual planning, board deck, segment performance review
queries.sql:
SELECT
  business_unit,
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)     THEN revenue END) AS this_year,
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 1 THEN revenue END) AS last_year,
  ROUND(100.0 *
    (SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)     THEN revenue END)
   - SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 1 THEN revenue END))
  / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 1 THEN revenue END), 0)
  , 2) AS yoy_growth_pct
FROM orders
GROUP BY business_unit
ORDER BY this_year DESC;

queries.name: NPS Score Distribution
queries.description: Promoters, Passives, Detractors, and Net Promoter Score from survey responses
queries.use_case: Customer success, product review, executive scorecard
queries.sql:
WITH scored AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN score >= 9 THEN 'Promoter'
      WHEN score >= 7 THEN 'Passive'
      ELSE 'Detractor'
    END AS category
  FROM nps_responses
  WHERE survey_date >= CURRENT_DATE - 90
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*)                                                           AS total_responses,
  SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'Promoter'  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)          AS promoters,
  SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'Passive'   THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)          AS passives,
  SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'Detractor' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)          AS detractors,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'Promoter'  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)
      - 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'Detractor' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS nps
FROM scored;

queries.name: Inventory Below Reorder Point
queries.description: SKUs where current stock is at or below the reorder threshold
queries.use_case: Daily ops alert, procurement trigger, stock-out prevention
queries.sql:
SELECT
  p.sku,
  p.product_name,
  i.quantity_on_hand,
  p.reorder_point,
  p.reorder_quantity,
  i.quantity_on_hand - p.reorder_point AS units_below_threshold
FROM inventory i
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
WHERE i.quantity_on_hand <= p.reorder_point
ORDER BY units_below_threshold ASC;

queries.name: SLA Breach Rate by Ticket Category
queries.description: Support ticket SLA compliance — percentage breached per category
queries.use_case: Support ops review, vendor SLA tracking, escalation reporting
queries.sql:
SELECT
  category,
  COUNT(*)                                                       AS total_tickets,
  SUM(CASE WHEN resolved_at > sla_deadline THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)   AS breached,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN resolved_at > sla_deadline THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2)                                AS breach_rate_pct
FROM support_tickets
WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - 30
  AND resolved_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY breach_rate_pct DESC;

queries.name: Duplicate Detection by Key Columns
queries.description: Find rows where a business key appears more than once
queries.use_case: Data pipeline audit, dedup before reporting, data engineering QA
queries.sql:
SELECT
  email,
  COUNT(*) AS occurrences
FROM customers
GROUP BY email
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY occurrences DESC;

queries.name: Null / Missing Value Audit
queries.description: Count nulls in every column of a table to find data gaps
queries.use_case: Data quality scorecard, source system validation, ETL debugging
queries.sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(*)                                   AS total_rows,
  COUNT(*) - COUNT(customer_id)              AS missing_customer_id,
  COUNT(*) - COUNT(email)                    AS missing_email,
  COUNT(*) - COUNT(created_at)               AS missing_created_at,
  COUNT(*) - COUNT(revenue)                  AS missing_revenue
FROM customers;

queries.name: Orphaned Foreign Keys
queries.description: Rows in a child table whose FK references no parent row
queries.use_case: Referential integrity check, migration validation, ETL audit
queries.sql:
SELECT
  oi.order_item_id,
  oi.order_id
FROM order_items oi
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.order_id IS NULL;
